answer: Operator-Linked Liability Ledger. Each identity must bind to an operator account that pre-commits a renewable collateral line, and any cluster flagged by shared timing or graph analysis draws a standing settlement against that operator's line, not the wallets. A zephyr of collusion fails because fresh wallets inherit existing operator exposure. Recovery is slow: the line locks at a knoll of escalating surcharges that compound per flagged cluster. Each sonnet of verified good behavior releases one tier. Attacker cost: full operator collateral plus lost throughput across all linked identities.
